Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my injuries, if that's okay.
Q: That works. Can you tell me where you were driving when the collision happened?
A: I was on a main road in Sugar Land, heading toward a shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I
was already stopped at a light.
Q: And what happened next?
A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. The other car had hit
me while I was stopped.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle and spaek with the other driver?
A: Yes, we exchanged information. He said he looked down at his phone for a second and didn't see the stopped
traffic in time.
Q: Were there any police or emergency responders at the scene?
A: An officer came out and took a report. I think the paramedics checked on me too, but I didn't go in an ambulance.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: I went to urgent care the same day. They told me I had a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy
twice a week since then.
Q: How would you describe your pain right now?
A: My neck is stiff, especially when I turn to check my blnid spot. My lower back aches after I sit for more than about
thirty minutes, and I've had trouble sleeping through the night.
Q: Have you missed any work or daily activities because of the injuries?
A: I've had to leave early a couple of times because sitting at my desk is uncomfortable. I've also cut back on yard
work and lifting groceries.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm following my doctor's plan and I want to get back to normal as soon as I can.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
